expectation: Cytoplasmic granular CD68 in macrophages/monocytes: a distinct minority of cells with discrete cell-shaped signal, often clustered or in aggregates, scattered through tumour/stroma, with dimmer signal in other cells.
observed: A: discrete yellow cell-sized spots across all cores, dense in some regions and sparse in others, with large clusters in the left-hand core. B/C: sparse, cell-shaped yellow cells among unstained blue nuclei. D: yellow cytoplasmic signal around and between nuclei. E: CD68 cells overlap partly with CD163 and also sit apart from it, as expected for a moderate relation.
why: A distinct subset of cell-shaped cytoplasmic CD68 cells, clustered in places and often overlapping CD163, with no haze or uniform glow.
